items.title: Ubuntu still has not released patch for Linux 0day RCE in almost 3 weeks
items.blurb: No patched kernels are available yet for 22.04, 24.04, or 26.04 despite a CVSS 9.8 rating.

items.title: Shopify Overexposed Scans GKE Ingresses and Cloud Run for Exposure
items.blurb: Shopify has introduced Overexposed. This internal scanner locates Kubernetes Ingresses on GKE and Cloud Run services. It checks for those that are accessible from the internet without authentication By Claudio Masolo
